# Care.com

> Care.com is a comprehensive caregiving marketplace connecting families and employers with vetted care providers across childcare, senior care, pet care, housekeeping, and related services.

Care.com operates as a multi-sided platform serving both care seekers and care providers, with additional offerings including HomePay (household payroll services), CareBenefits (employer workforce solutions), and business listing tools for care agencies and facilities. The platform emphasizes safety through background checks and caregiver vetting.

## Key Topics

- Childcare marketplace
- Senior care
- Pet care
- Housekeeping services
- Nanny and babysitter hiring
- Background checks
- Safety features
- HomePay payroll
- CareBenefits employer solutions
- Caregiver recruitment
- Business listings
- Cost calculator
- Mobile apps (iOS/Android)
- Care directory

## Core Marketplace

- [Care.com Homepage](https://www.care.com): Main caregiving marketplace for childcare, senior care, pet care, housekeeping
- [Find Child Care Near Me That Fits Your Schedule](https://www.care.com/child-care): Childcare marketplace for nannies, babysitters, and daycare providers
- [Browse for Care Directory](https://www.care.com/care-directory): Directory to browse hundreds of care service categories
- [Cost of Care Calculator](https://www.care.com/cost): Calculator for childcare, senior care, and household services pricing

## Business & Employer Solutions

- [CareBenefits by Care.com](https://www.care.com/business): Employer care solutions and workforce benefits for work-life balance
- [List Your Business](https://www.care.com/app/pn-business): Business listing for childcare centers and service providers
- [List Your Business - Senior Care](https://www.care.com/app/pn-business/senior-care): Senior care business listing and caregiver recruitment platform
- [List Your Business - Camps](https://www.care.com/app/pn-business/camps): Camp registration and enrollment software for activity providers
- [Care.com HomePay](https://www.care.com/homepay): Nanny tax and payroll service for household employees

## Mobile Applications

- [Care.com: Hire Caregivers App - App Store](https://www.care.com/careiTunesDownload.do): iOS app for hiring caregivers with background checks and safety features
- [Care.com: Hire Caregivers - Google Play](https://www.care.com/carePlayStoreDownload.do): Android app for finding quality care providers and household help
